title: Artificial Intelligence Consultant
job_description: JD for AI Architect The main responsibilities include : Design end-to-end AI platform/solutions, from data ingestion to model deployment and monitoring. Translate business problems into scalable AI architecture and technical specifications. Collaborate with various stakeholders that include data scientists, engineers, product managers and business stakeholders in realizing AI technology. Ensure AI solutions meet performance, scalability and reliability requirements. Incorporate security, governance, and compliance into AI system design. Provide architecture, solution and project support related to AI realization. Establish and maintain the AI security guardrail baseline Required qualifications : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI data science, AI or related field. 5+ years of experience in software architecture, data engineering and AI/ML system design & implementation. Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning and data engineering concepts. Experience and knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and AI services. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java and Scala. Knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture and distributed systems. Strong problem solving skills and communication skills.
